picker.editWithoutApplying: Edit my custom theme without applying it

menu.startFromTip: The preset your theme begins with. Changing it replaces your token values. Undo brings them back.
menu.schemeTip: How the browser draws its own controls: scrollbars, menus and pickers.
menu.shareTip: One JSON document with your theme. An imported theme stays a draft until you save.

bar.label: Theme editor
bar.fixMore_one: Fix the syntax error in {{file}} and {{count}} more file.
bar.fixMore_other: Fix the syntax error in {{file}} and {{count}} more files.
bar.savedToast: Theme saved. Your other devices pick it up.

notes.conflictTitle: Changed on disk while you were editing.
notes.restored: ({{time}}). It is not saved yet: save it, or discard it to go back to your saved theme.
notes.safeEdit: This page stays on {{theme}} while you fix your theme. Select Custom to wear it again.
notes.lightOverDark: Light tells the browser to draw its own controls (scrollbars, menus, pickers) light. Your surfaces are still dark.
notes.startedLightToast: Surfaces, text and status colors now start from a light set. Brand colors are kept.
notes.darkOverLight: Your surfaces are light but the scheme is Dark, so the browser draws its own controls dark.

preview.title: Preview.
preview.message: Your changes are kept as a draft. Nothing is saved until you go back and press Save.

visual.hiddenChange: A changed value is hidden here
visual.follows: Follows {{base}}. Pick a color to set it yourself

fonts.uploadHint: A .woff2, .woff, .ttf or .otf file. It is kept in your fonts folder and served by this server, so no browser calls a font service.
fonts.removeMessage: {{file}} is deleted from your fonts folder. A theme that names it falls back to the next font in its stack.

export.title: Export this theme
export.intro: One JSON document with your token files and, if you want, your free CSS. Share it, or keep it as a backup. Fonts you uploaded are not included: the theme names the font, and whoever imports it adds the file.
export.name: Theme name
export.includeFree: Include my free CSS: components/ and custom.css
export.copyFailed: Select all and copy the text in the box.

import.title: Import a theme
import.intro: Paste a theme document or choose its file. Check tells you what it carries before anything changes. Applying it loads it as a draft over your theme: Save keeps it, Discard brings yours back.
import.tokensOnly: Tokens only, leave my free CSS as it is
import.notJson: This is not valid JSON. Paste the whole document, from the first brace to the last.
import.notATheme: This is not a Synthseek theme. A theme document starts with "synthseek": "theme".
import.newerContract: This theme was written for a newer Synthseek. Update this server, then import it again.
import.invalidFile: This theme has a file Synthseek cannot read: {{detail}}.
import.syntax: This theme has a file that does not parse: {{detail}}.
import.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a theme.
import.tokens_one: Sets {{count}} token. Any token it leaves out keeps the {{preset}} value.
import.tokens_other: Sets {{count}} tokens. Any token it leaves out keeps the {{preset}} value.
import.freeCss: Carries free CSS in {{files}}. Free CSS can restyle or hide parts of the interface. Import tokens only if you do not trust where this came from.
import.removed_one: {{count}} remote resource was removed. A theme cannot load anything from another site.
import.removed_other: {{count}} remote resources were removed. A theme cannot load anything from another site.
import.appliedToast: Theme loaded as a draft. Save to keep it, Discard to go back to yours.

css.readonly: Written by Synthseek. It records which preset the theme started from, the version of the token list it was written against, and which steps the visual editor keeps in line with their base color.
css.unreadable: Synthseek could not read this file. Fix it on the server, or save to replace it.
css.errors_one: {{count}} syntax error. Save is off until it is fixed.
css.errors_other: {{count}} syntax errors. Save is off until they are fixed.
css.diskChanged: This file changed on disk while you were editing.
css.openFileFirst: Open a CSS file to insert into.
css.newFileTaken: A file with that name already exists.

problems.tooLarge: This file is larger than a theme file can be
problems.notAVariable: Only token values belong in this file; this is removed when you save
problems.internalClass: Class names are internal and can change in any release; target a data-part instead
problems.remoteResource: A theme cannot load from another site; this is removed when you save
problems.unsupportedAtRule: This at-rule is not applied to the app

insert.hint: Click one to insert it where the cursor is.

history.title: History
history.tip: Each save keeps a version, the last 8 per file. Restore loads one into the editor; it is not saved until you press Save.
history.generated: Written by Synthseek. It keeps no versions.
history.restoredToast: Version loaded into the editor. Save to keep it.
history.restoreFailed: That version could not be loaded.
